notes.title: New stage & enhanced solo mode
notes.notes:
New gimmicks

Bush

Enemies unable to see you while you are inside. 

Acceleration floor

You can dash in the direction of the arrow.

River

It is not passeble, but

your attacks will pass through.

Practice Mode

"Level" added.

You can advance one level by defeating the CPU.

The number of CPUs increases as the level advances.

If you lose, you are back to 1.

The highest level you reached will be recorded.

-------------------------------------------------------------

Exciting Update!

The PTF stage was just a vast grassy field with inorganic blocks...

And the CPU battle (practice mode) was 

the same work over and over again...

So this time!

Three stage gimmicks added!

And a challenge what the more you defeat, the more [i]Oni[/i] multiply added!

We hope this update bring

・Diversification of player strategies

・Increasing the feeling of a crazy party

・You can also challenge your personal best in silence

,etc.

We hope you'll use it to expand your enjoyment!

notes.title: 360-degree Update
notes.notes:
All animals can move  360-degree freely.
All animals can use the skill 360-degree freely.
Update rooster's water skill.
